mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate above 4.3% within a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.2 percentage points over a 3-month period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicate contracting household demand, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 0.5% over a 2-month period.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 310), a federal funds rate increase above 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 310 and FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.5 indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where INDPRO exceeds 100.5.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payrolls below 158,000 in a single month signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS falls below 158,000.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1250), a decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) below 700,000 signals reduced household spending capacity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1250 and RSAFS declines > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1250 and RSAFS declines by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both decline > 0.5% in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST decline by more than 0.5% over a 2-month period.
